assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for an underlying arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Diagnosis code I34.0 is associated with nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
A cardiac event monitor with CPT code 93271 is ordered.
The monitor is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes to evaluate for potential atrial fibrillation or other conduction abnormalities contributing to these symptoms.
Diagnosis code R42 is associated with the symptoms (dizziness/giddiness).
The service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical indication of evaluating conduction abnormalities.
The denial was based on Reason Code PR-204.
